prerequisites: Knowledge of C or C++ as acquired in the first two semesters of computer science programs (alternatively: Rust).

learning_outcomes.text: Students know and understand essential components of operating systems. They can explain and evaluate the functionality of these elements and apply them with regard to energy-efficient virtualized environments.
Students have more precise knowledge of system interfaces for processes and for accessing distributed system resources.
Students are able to reflect on operating system concepts in the realization of applications and services with regard to their use.
Students can select suitable system interfaces for applications and services and use these interfaces in a structured manner.
Students are able to create operating system-related software for special applications and to communicate and demonstrate its use.

syllabus_topics: Tasks, types and structure of operating systems
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam. The ungraded examination is an experimental work, consisting of approximately 8 experiments.
